result.justification: The research objective is clearly stated and directly connects with a detailed methodology including design, sampling strategy, and data collection methods.

evidence.quote: The primary aim of this study was to evaluate how PCC changed during the COVID-19 pandemic period in long-term care facilities in Catalonia.
This multicenter observational retrospective study aimed to describe the perceptions of residents, family members, staff, and facility directors.
PCC was evaluated using the Person-Centered Care in Gerontology Services (PCC-G) questionnaire, a validated tool designed to assess the degree of person-centered care.
Data were analyzed at the NH level by aggregating responses from the different participant groups to obtain an overall mean representing the entire facility.
